title: Punjab political map source notes
scope: Production research notes for later dated regional maps. No playable map or territorial simulation is implemented by this file.
baseline: 1792, with explicit era changes for later material
implementation_status: not implemented by this research task
entity_model: Separate person, lineage, political office, territorial unit, and relation; each relation needs start/end dates, evidence and confidence. All relation_hook values below are design suggestions.

source_guards.guard: No fixed historical total of15–20 comparable states. Pick a dated map window and explicit level of aggregation; distinguish regions, forts, chiefships, states, and overlords.
Do not claim equal numbers or power for Sikh, Muslim, and Hindu polities. Preserve religious diversity; model ruler affiliation separately from population and relations.
source_guards.status: unsupported equality claim rejected; no population census inferred

source_guards.guard: The conventional twelve names do not imply twelve identical states or eleven direct neighbours. EOS describes eleven Dal Khalsa divisions plus Phulkian outside that command; branches and Phulkian states require separate actors.
Use the broad cis-Sutlej Samrala–Jagadhri zone; southern Hoshiarpur is not an adequate location for Karorsinghia. Precise1792 holdings still require mapping.
Gujrat in Punjab near the Chenab is a different place from Gujarat in western India. Store coordinates and region-qualified IDs.

Do not back-project later Barakzai Peshawar/Attock labels into a1790s snapshot. Peshawar circa1800 belongs in the Durrani succession context; verify each local office separately.1818 attestation is not a start date.
source_guards.status: Peshawar correction supported; Attock exact1792 office remains open

source_guards.guard: Jammu existed earlier, but Gulab Singh's ruling configuration belongs to1822 onward. Distinguish region, older dynasty, later Dogra house, and suzerain.
Separate Ranjit Singh of Lahore from Ranjit Singh of Bharatpur. Suraj Mal is historical by1792. Shared Jat identity is not proof of biological cousinhood, a permanent alliance, or one political unit.
source_guards.status: namesake correction supported; alleged kinship requires specific genealogy

source_guards.guard: Preserve both names but do not place the later Dholpur settlement unchanged in1792. Dynasty, territorial claim, and actual possession must be separate.
